His right palm firmly pushes a thick upright red rectangular STORYBOARD PANEL border toward the right edge, moving a cluster of three small generic monochrome doodle-animator portraits aside as a comic visual metaphor for making room. Keep ADB calm and confident; the other doodles supply the surprise. Keep lower-right duration area free of essential detail. No full scene or clutter.
TEXT EXACTLY: "MAKE ROOM." A single huge headline across top, broad heavy WHITE sans letters with substantial BLACK inner / RED middle / BLACK outer contours like reference2. Safe margins on every side, headline never covers eyes. No secondary copy, labels, name, fake success numbers, watermark, timestamp or screenshot UI.
